scope: forensic analysis of existing V2/V3 artifacts only; no training, inference, test evaluation, or promotion

v2_training_console_log.status: not found in V2 run directory, work/audit, or runs search
v2_training_console_log.consequence: V2 requested optimizer/lr are verified from args.yaml and LR values from results.csv, but console-resolved optimizer state cannot be independently confirmed.

training_configs.v3_warning: optimizer=auto ignored configured lr0=0.01; saved LR is not actual optimizer LR

previous_frozen_detector_benchmark_conte.qualification: prior raw detector benchmark, not V3; aggregate and geometrical triage, not adjudicated V3 outcomes

p0_banana10.user_authorized_adjudication: det_0000 classified merge_error; four GT marked correct per event log history from prior task
p0_banana10.qualification: direct visual-adjudication evidence for prior baseline benchmark image; not V3 validation per-image evidence

data_context.excluded_reason: train-side images connected to temporal near-duplicate groups crossing split boundaries
data_context.qualification: these are facts from training-data-quality-gate report; complete V2-to-V3 sample overlap and per-class loss impact are unavailable in this audit

root_cause_hypotheses_ranked.hypothesis: Training data/split and annotation changes confounded the comparison; the 62-image exclusion and use of a different dataset/config path can alter sample exposure.
root_cause_hypotheses_ranked.evidence: V2 used work/obb/seg_data_v2/seg.yaml; V3 used quality-gate train list over seg_data_training_prep_v1. Quality gate documents 62 removed train images and 250 true-crossing polygon rows in 231 label files.
root_cause_hypotheses_ranked.strength: high as a confound, not proven as cause
root_cause_hypotheses_ranked.missing: per-image/per-instance V2 vs V3 training-set manifests and controlled ablation

root_cause_hypotheses_ranked.hypothesis: Optimization dynamics changed materially: V3 optimizer auto resolved to AdamW lr=0.001429 and batch=1, while V2 args record AdamW lr0=0.0005 and batch=4.
root_cause_hypotheses_ranked.evidence: Both args.yaml files plus V3 console optimizer resolution. V3 LR trace is uniform across pg0/pg1/pg2 and decays to 4.97e-5 by epoch 40; V2 used different warmup/LR trace.
root_cause_hypotheses_ranked.strength: high that settings differ; medium/low causality
root_cause_hypotheses_ranked.missing: matched controlled run varying only optimizer/batch or logged gradient/update diagnostics

root_cause_hypotheses_ranked.hypothesis: V3 continued fitting the training distribution while validation gains plateaued/regressed, consistent with overfitting or a train/validation distribution mismatch.
root_cause_hypotheses_ranked.evidence: All four train losses decreased from epoch1 to40, while validation losses from best epoch38 to epoch40 increased for box, segmentation and DFL; aggregate mAP50-95 sum peaks at epoch38 and declines by epoch40. Validation curves fluctuate substantially.
root_cause_hypotheses_ranked.missing: independent validation groups and repeated seeds; 40 epochs alone cannot diagnose cause

root_cause_hypotheses_ranked.hypothesis: Annotation geometry/noise (including genuine polygon crossings) may limit segmentation quality, particularly under instance overlap.
root_cause_hypotheses_ranked.evidence: Quality gate found 250 true crossing rows in 231 files; prior P0 banana10 recorded merge/geometry issue.
root_cause_hypotheses_ranked.strength: moderate as risk, weak as explanation for V3-vs-V2 delta
root_cause_hypotheses_ranked.missing: V3 per-image predictions matched against adjudicated annotations and label-level error analysis

root_cause_hypotheses_ranked.evidence: Saved V2 and V3 args show the audited augmentation fields are identical (mosaic1, flip LR .5, scale .5, translate .1, RandAugment, etc.).
root_cause_hypotheses_ranked.strength: low as a between-run main effect; interaction with changed data/batch/optimizer remains possible
root_cause_hypotheses_ranked.missing: ablation; no evidence to isolate interactions

root_cause_hypotheses_ranked.hypothesis: Wrong or incompatible checkpoint initialization caused regression.
root_cause_hypotheses_ranked.evidence: V3 args reference the verified V2 best checkpoint hash and the training log says 561/561 parameters transferred.
root_cause_hypotheses_ranked.missing: full model-weight tensor equivalence at initialization is not recoverable from post-training artifacts without loading training state

root_cause_hypotheses_ranked.hypothesis: Class imbalance caused the specific regression.
root_cause_hypotheses_ranked.evidence: Quality-gate train instances are banana2754/apple448/orange411, so banana dominates rather than being the minority class. Image-level balance/visibility and batch sampling are not summarized.
root_cause_hypotheses_ranked.strength: low / unsupported as a simple minority-class explanation
root_cause_hypotheses_ranked.missing: per-image class distribution, object size/occlusion strata, per-class loss trajectories

conclusion.overfitting: possible but not established; curve pattern is consistent with some late train/validation divergence
conclusion.regression_timing: already visible at first recorded V3 validation epoch versus the V2 best validation checkpoint; V3 improves its own early curve through epoch38, then slightly recedes by epoch40. No measurement was taken between V2 initialization and the first V3 epoch.
conclusion.epoch38: best observed epoch by Ultralytics fitness (box plus mask mAP50-95 on the same validation split); it is the correct in-run selected checkpoint, not proof of generalization or independent optimum because it was selected on that validation set.
conclusion.decision: NO-GO for V3 promotion; retain V2 as current baseline. No test evaluation was performed.

next_experiment_recommendation.status: recommend a separately approved controlled ablation, not execute now
next_experiment_recommendation.design: Freeze one dataset manifest and hashes; use V2 initialization; explicitly pin optimizer and resolved LR, batch/gradient accumulation, schedule, augmentation, epochs and seed. Compare a minimal pair changing only one factor at a time (first reproduce V2 training recipe on quality-gate data; then separately test the 62-image exclusion if scientifically desired). Keep validation group-aware and report per-class/size/occlusion strata; preserve a final untouched test.
next_experiment_recommendation.reason: Current V2/V3 comparison changes dataset exposure and optimization behavior together; attribution is not identifiable.
